Hi Ava —

Thanks for volunteering to run the upcoming QBR with our execs. We want to make sure the session is tight and that you have the right level of granularity on our book. Two asks from our side:

1) A reconciled deal-level ledger that shows current ARR, last committed close date, and any gating items per opportunity.
2) One-paragraph owner narratives for the top-6 deals calling out next steps and legal/ procurement dependencies.

I've attached a short PDF with our expectation and a list of internal questions — nothing too long. Can you confirm whether you need any extra artifacts from my team?

Appreciate it — excited to get into details.

Best,

Looping in my reconciliation notes — pulled from Salesforce and cross-checked to billing. High-level deltas:

- SOL-201: +$45k ARR vs. forecast. Cause: upsell moved from FY28 Q1 to FY27 Q4 after commitment from engineering pilot. Owner: Laura.
- SOL-312: -$120k ARR vs. forecast. Cause: procurement delayed order form pending security addendum. Owner: Priyom.
- SOL-089: No change; marked close-for-realistic probability drop from 75% -> 55% based on last contact.

I've added comments directly in deal_ledger_v1.xlsx (column: "recon_notes"). There's a sheet called "open_gates" listing specific gating items and owners. Laura — can you paste your owner narratives into the "owner_notes" tab (one paragraph per deal) by EOD? Priyom — can you confirm the procurement timeline for SOL-312?

Also: forecast confidence metric for the book is currently 0.68 (weighted avg). We'll present both weighted and unweighted numbers in the QBR.

-Marcus

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-09-06T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR materials + request for deal-level ledger (owner narratives)

Attaching owner narratives inline per request — top 4 writeups below (I'll add remaining two to the sheet tonight).

- SOL-201 (Atlas Diagnostics) — Narrative: Pilot completed; engineering sign-off secured 8/28. Expect PO for core inference licenses this quarter. Next step: finalize SOW and send PO. Legal review clean; CS assigned. Confidence: 80%.

- SOL-312 (Horizon Retail) — Narrative: Procurement has flagged new vendor onboarding checklist; waiting on security addendum signature. Expected procurement completion: 9/28 (slippage of ~3 weeks). Action: Priyom to escalate to procurement lead and request a hard date. Confidence: 40%.

- SOL-089 (Bytewave) — Narrative: Healthy interest but buyer calendar is thin; last contact suggested budget holds until next fiscal. Next step: move to targeted demo with technical champion (week of 9/13). Confidence: 55%.

- SOL-507 (Neuma Health) — Narrative: Transactional upsell; customer requests 100% uptime SLA and dedicated capacity estimate. We have a technical call 9/8 to scope dedicated requirements. Next step: present costed Dedicated proposal. Confidence: 65%.

Flags: For the QBR deck I recommend we call out SOL-312 as the primary risk, and SOL-201 as a fast-close opportunity.

Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

[Will paste these to the "owner_notes" tab in deal_ledger_v1.xlsx and add two more entries by 9/6 EOD.]
